designationHistory.name: Union Slough Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Union Slough Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7976 on September 19, 1938.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Established in 1938 as a migratory waterfowl refuge, Union Slough National Wildlife Refuge provides critical habitat for native prairie and wetland wildlife in a landscape dominated by intensive agriculture.
